card.name: Word before 'among' or 'in patients'
card.fires_on: Comparison or frequency words (more frequently, higher, especially, a percentage) right before a group is named, as in 'among the elderly' or 'in patients treated with'.

modes.label: Frequency/comparison word
modes.description: Words like frequently or higher that set up a comparison across patient groups.
modes.example: edema was reported more<< frequently>> in patients treated with pioglitaz

modes.label: Percentage before a group
modes.description: A percent figure in a rate comparison, right before 'among' and a group size.

modes.label: Emphasis word before group
modes.description: Words like especially or closely that precede a population or monitoring phrase.

card.writes: It promotes 'among' and 'amongst' and suppresses 'in patients' words such as chez, bei and hos, so it steers toward 'among' wording.
card.plain: It fires on words that are about to introduce which group of people a rate or risk applies to, like 'among the elderly'.
